source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What execution resource does a persistent automatic agent need?

options.text: A phone connection to a local computer that may be sleeping
options.feedback: Remote control does not make an unavailable local machine an always-on service.

options.text: An available host on which its operations can run
options.feedback: Persistent operation depends on an execution environment being available when work is triggered.

options.text: A saved skill folder on a laptop that is disconnected during scheduled runs
options.feedback: Saved instructions remain available as files, but scheduled operations still need a running, available execution environment.

options.text: A working installation on a computer used during the initial demonstration
options.feedback: An earlier demonstration shows past availability. Persistent work needs the execution host available when later work is triggered.
